title: Bludit plugin submission
description: One file per plugin inside plugins/. The filename must be <id>.json. Every field that also exists inside the zip is compared against it by the workflow. Fields derived by CI (sha256, size) must not be present.

id.description: Directory name created inside bl-plugins. Must match the filename of the submission.

description.description: One line, no line breaks. Must be identical to plugin-data.description in languages/en.json.

license.description: SPDX identifier, for example MIT or GPL-3.0-or-later. Use PROPRIETARY for a closed licence. Must be identical to the license in the metadata.json of the plugin.

compatible.description: Comma separated list of major.minor Bludit versions, for example 4.0 or 4.0,4.1

version.description: Must be identical to the version inside the metadata.json of the plugin.

download.description: GitHub release asset. Archives generated by GitHub (/archive/*.zip) are not accepted, their bytes are not stable and the checksum would not hold.

type.description: Leave empty for a regular plugin. Must be identical to the type in the metadata.json of the plugin, which may omit it.
